`authority-v2.json` is the unchanged 622,582-byte independent Python output,
SHA256 `7328ea2102c9ac993281bd732590c3e734eda26a3d180c2fa98bbd37da02c6b4`.
Python 3.14 and 3.9 reproduced exactly under approved successor lock
`97a368ab412ca1a77ef8f8770d935958684df23d9e9ae66d37ff74957bbaf0e0`.
The failed first input-selector attempt remains preserved in the external prep

The exact approved producer, independent inherited primitive/model, input recipes,
catalog, policy and source-provenance copies are retained in `producer/`.
The copied lock contains original absolute provenance paths, not portable execution
paths. Do not silently rewrite or regenerate this frozen oracle from Go outputs.

The registry tests execute 48 registry positives, 92 registry refusals, 12 raw
canonical cases, 12 guard projections and four checkpoint-role cases. The complete
54/102 inventory also contains six positive finality frames and ten frame refusals
reserved for the core consumer. Registry tests do not establish normal PoW,

Lifecycle store tests use only visibly public synthetic seeds derived from the
approved input recipe. They never load an operator's real checkpoint key.
